# fish completion for mnema, generated by `mnema completion fish`.
#
# For this shell, now:
#     mnema completion fish | source
# For every shell, once:
#     mnema completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/mnema.fish
#
# It completes verbs, subcommands, option names, and the values of an option whose
# declaration enumerates them, each with what its own help says. It never runs
# mnema to answer a Tab.

function __mnema_commands --description 'the subcommands one level of the tree offers'
    switch "$argv[1]"
        case ''
            echo 'init decision link unlink memory observe retract skill stack task promote status brief recall rules rules-file switch inherit verify witness check site search show timeline refs audit diagram export usage resume repl why commits aging trailer commit-hook key tail doctor completion mcp run before-a-write tally corrections help'
        case 'decision'
            echo 'record move supersede import help'
        case 'skill'
            echo 'create move export provenance help'
        case 'stack'
            echo 'add remove help'
        case 'task'
            echo 'create move handoff next guard help'
        case 'switch'
            echo 'off on'
        case 'inherit'
            echo 'set update help'
        case 'witness'
            echo 'stamp upgrade sigstore'
        case 'check'
            echo 'declare run help'
        case 'audit'
            echo 'accountability antipatterns exposure help'
        case 'commit-hook'
            echo 'install uninstall suggest help'
        case 'key'
            echo 'restore request enroll github sigstore revoke protect unprotect help'
        case 'tail'
            echo 'list prune help'
        case 'run'
            echo 'start end help'
    end
end

function __mnema_path --description 'the subcommand path the line has reached'
    set -l path ""
    set -l skipped 0
    for word in (commandline -opc)
        if test $skipped -eq 0
            set skipped 1
            continue
        end
        if string match -q -- '-*' "$word"
            continue
        end
        set -l children (__mnema_commands "$path" | string split ' ')
        if contains -- "$word" $children
            if test -z "$path"
                set path "$word"
            else
                set path "$path $word"
            end
        end
    end
    echo "$path"
end

function __mnema_at --description 'true when the line has reached this path'
    test (__mnema_path) = "$argv[1]"
end

complete -c mnema -e

# mnema
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'init' -d 'establish a mnema project in the current directory'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'decision' -d 'record a decision, or move one, in the current project'

complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'mcp' -d 'run the mnema MCP server over stdio (for an agent host)'

complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'tally' -d 'answer a host’s Stop or PreCompact hook with what the session wrote and recorded'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'corrections' -d 'record what a person corrected in a session as proposed decisions, for a Stop hook'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'help' -d 'display help for command'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -s h -l help

complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -a 'sigstore' -d 'record that this identity is the one a Sigstore certificate names, so a bundle `mnema witness sigstore` files speaks for it in `mnema verify --against-sigstore`'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -a 'revoke' -d 'retire a key from this identity, from this point forward'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -a 'protect' -d 'encrypt this machine\'s private keys at rest with the passphrase in MNEMA_KEY_PASSPHRASE'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -a 'unprotect' -d 'write this machine\'s private keys back in the clear (needs MNEMA_KEY_PASSPHRASE)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -a 'help' -d 'display help for command'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key enroll"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "key enroll"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

# mnema run
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -a 'start' -d 'open a session for an agent (facts written in it are pinned to it)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -a 'end' -d 'close a session (by default the one MNEMA_RUN names)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -a 'help' -d 'display help for command'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "run"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'
